description: This file declares the 'RemotePlugin' class within the Rust namespace, which implements the 'Rust::IPlugin' interface. It includes method declarations for initializing, deinitializing, handling WebSocket communication, plugin activation/deactivation, and invocation, along with private methods for launching a remote process and sending messages. The class maintains pointers to service interfaces, process ID, socket server, configuration, and authentication token.
